description: Startup portfolio health, growth bottlenecks, CRM follow-ups and BizPulse agent actions.

env.name: BIZPULSE_STARTUP_ID
env.title: Startup id
env.description: Default BizPulse startup for reviews and CRM follow-ups. Tools also accept startupId.

env.name: BIZPULSE_COMMAND
env.title: BizPulse CLI command
env.description: The pulse CLI, e.g. pulse or an absolute path. It must already be signed in (pulse login) unless an API key is set below.

env.name: PULSE_API_URL
env.title: BizPulse API endpoint
env.description: Optional. Defaults to the pulse CLI's saved endpoint.

env.name: PULSE_API_KEY
env.title: BizPulse agent API key
env.description: Optional. Defaults to the pulse CLI's saved login.
